title: O10a 浏览器测量：点击发送到本轮患者回答首次可见的耗时（规则模拟器）
worktree_head: run-time HEAD (see git_head_sha in the run)
model_policy: zero real model calls; NEXENT_MODE=simulator (rule simulator) only

method.browser: Playwright-core + installed Edge/Chrome; the driver starts web/e2e/o10a_stack.py (temporary databases, NEXENT_MODE=simulator, loopback FastAPI serving web/dist).

timestamps.clickT: capture-phase click listener on the 发送 button records performance.now() at dispatch
timestamps.postT: a fetch wrapper records performance.now() when the POST /api/sessions/{sid}/ask response resolves
timestamps.visibleT: a MutationObserver on .dialog-log records performance.now() when a new .turn.patient .text:not(.faint) answer is inserted (the loading … is .faint and excluded)
timestamps.paintT: double requestAnimationFrame after visibleT, approximating the first painted frame

durations.click_to_paint: paintT - clickT (what the student actually sees)

method.correlation: the POST response body carries the saved event (event_id, seq, answer); the driver checks the DOM answer equals that event and that the event is the one persisted in the session.

ui_existing_latency_definition.start: const t = performance.now() immediately before mutate() POST
ui_existing_latency_definition.end: setLatency(performance.now() - t) immediately after onSavedAsk merges the event into React state
ui_existing_latency_definition.display: tooltip title `应答 ${(latency/1000).toFixed(1)} 秒` on the 已问 N 项 counter
ui_existing_latency_definition.meaning: click -> (POST response received + response body read + event merged into React state), i.e. roughly the response instant, NOT the DOM paint

runs.question: 有高血压吗
runs.outcome: no visible answer; unconfirmed error shown; server already saved the event

finding.difference: 界面显示的耗时与实际测量含义不同
finding.detail: Training.tsx 的 `应答 X 秒` 起于 POST 前、止于事件并入 React 状态后，约等于点击->收到响应（本轮模拟器 click->response 16.3~22.8ms），不含 React 渲染/提交/绘制。学生真正'看见'回答的时点是 paint（click->paint 22.9~33.3ms），比该显示晚约 6~12ms（response->paint）。此外显示按 toFixed(1) 舍入到 0.1 秒，本轮显示为 `应答 0.0 秒`，丢失了毫秒分辨率。
finding.reproduce: OUT=local-only/o10a-latency node web/e2e/o10a-latency.mjs  （逐轮 JSON 与校验见 OUT/run.json）
finding.boundary: 本轮是规则模拟器的测量方法验收，数值为毫秒级单次快照，不代表真实模型的 5 秒目标；真实模型点击->首字可见仍待单独实测。
